newsitem.title: USA: PP&L shuts Susquehanna nuclear unit.
newsitem.headline: PP&L shuts Susquehanna nuclear unit.

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc said operators at its Susquehanna nuclear power plant near Berwick, Pa., manually shut down the Unit 1 reactor Tuesday evening in anticipation of a loss of vacuum in the unit's main condenser.
PP&L said it expects the unit to be shut down for about a week while repairs and maintenance are performed.
It said the unit was shut down when fluctuations in a system that removes gases from the condenser caused a reduction in vacuum.
The condenser removes heat from steam leaving the unit's main turbine.
